title: Popup Menus show flash of desktop when opened
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable, v4.5.dev1.official [97241ffea], v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397]
- Not reproducible in: 
  - v4.2.1.stable (does take longer to change between menus though)
  - v4.5.dev3.official [28089c40c], but that has [its own popup menu problems](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/106433) so this might be relevant again once they're solved(?)
  - v4.5.dev4.official [209a446e3], same as dev3

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev2 - Linux Mint 20.3 (Una) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (nvidia; 535.230.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Popup menus show a brief flash of desktop behind when opening. Sometimes you can see icons, other times just the wallpaper. It's fairly random whether it happens on any single instance of a menu opening, but if you repeat it rapidly (eg. by moving the mouse back and forth over the scene, project, debug etc. menu buttons) you will certainly see it.

Does not happen in single window mode. Does not happen in other applications. Doesn't appear to happen in project manager. No difference between 1 and 2 monitors.

I can't capture it with OBS - while it is running, the glitch doesn't happen. Here's a _simulation_ of how it looks:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e1bec09-c72d-45c2-b0e8-30bc5cd15df2)

<details><summary>and here's a phone video (⚠️ rapid flashing - I set a bright background so it would capture easier, apologies)</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2a6c308-41ed-40af-a4e3-ccdd598b6c0f

</details>

Possibly a relation of #81732 ?
